Camera Running on the stylised guest stand-in. On the real kiosk this layer is the live camera feed.

This console is the review harness, not part of the kiosk. On the showroom unit the screen is touch-only: no cursor, no keyboard, no exposed settings. Session auto-resets after 75 seconds of stillness.

Design specification

One kiosk, ten screens, six recoverable states. Everything below is what the build enforces: the palette is fixed to six values plus a metal ramp, the type scale has five steps, and no screen asks for more than three decisions.

Palette

Ivory#F8F4ED · showroom ground
Warm beige#E4D8C3 · plates, cards
Champagne#D9BE87 · guides, eyebrows
Soft black#15120E · mirror canvas, CTAs
Metal ramp5 stops · jewellery + one hairline only
Emerald#2E6A55 · detected, ready, saved
Ruby#8F2C2C · camera and network faults
Muted#7A6F60 · labels, codes, captions

Touch ergonomics

76 pxMinimum height for any primary button; 104 px square for the mirror-side tools. Nothing smaller than 52 px is tappable.
Lower thirdEvery primary action sits between 60 % and 96 % of screen height — inside comfortable reach on a 55" portrait-mounted panel.
3 decisionsHard cap per screen. Categories are the one five-way choice, and they are full-height cards rather than a list.

Photography

Every image slot is addressed by product code and resolves best-source-first, so a shoot can be delivered one piece at a time without the kiosk ever showing a gap.

1stWorn shotworn/<code>.jpg — the model photographed in that exact piece. Becomes the mirror as shot; nothing composited.
2ndCut-outcutout/<code>.png over model/portrait.jpg or model/hand.jpg, placed at the body anchors.
3rdDrawnThe parametric SVG piece on the stand-in figure — the state this prototype ships in.
SlotFileSizeDirection
Mirror, wornworn/VCJ-KN-2841.jpg1600 × 1200 Framed identically to the model plates, or the mirror jumps between pieces
Mirror, basemodel/portrait.jpg · model/hand.jpg1600 × 1200 Head-and-shoulders and raised forearm, same setup, plain dark ground
Cut-outcutout/VCJ-KN-2841.pngAlpha, trimmed Straight-on, no baked shadow — the kiosk adds shadow and specular
Productproduct/VCJ-KN-2841.jpg1000 × 1000 Ivory sweep, 12 % margin, no props. Carousel, details, wishlist, handoff
Categorycategory/necklaces.jpg800 × 1100 One hero piece; the plate carries an ivory scrim so the name stays legible
Welcomeeditorial/hero.jpg1400 × 1800 Left third kept quiet — the headline sits over it

State inventory

StateTriggerWhat the guest seesWay out
FittingFirst entry to the mirror“Preparing your fitting” with a determinate barClears itself in ≤ 1.6 s
Piece loadingNew piece tappedSmall caption above the carousel; the mirror stays liveClears on placement, ~0.7 s
Camera faultFeed drops or is refused“The camera isn't responding”Try again · browse without the mirror
Detection lostGuest leaves the frame > 3 s“We've lost you for a moment” with lighting adviceI'm back in frame · choose something else
Catalogue offlineNetwork or CMS failure“The collection is taking a moment”; saved pieces preservedTry again · call an associate
Timeout75 s without touch“Are you still browsing?” with a 15 s ringI'm still here · end session · auto-reset

No state names a component, a model, or a tracker. The guest is never shown the words camera permission, mesh, landmark, or render.
